If I understand your problem from a quick read, I noticed this as well - it has to do with a change with reactiveUI not liking HTML text strings (you can workaround for now by either changing the source or using tags$table, etc. to generate your html.  I think it is being fixed:

https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/65
